snippet.title: Developer Update | Season 18: Wuyang, Progression 2.0, Stadium Updates, & More
snippet.description:
Season 18 is shaping up to be a big one, and the team is hyped to tell you all about it!

Join Aaron Keller for a rundown of all the huge things happening in Season 18, and trust us, the list is long.

After that, Kenny Hudson gives us a deeper look at Wuyang’s ability kit, a few of the changes coming to Roadhog, and a sneak peek at some of the crazy new Hero Perks.

Then, learn more about Progression 2.0 and the Comp rank reset from Brallan Saucedo and Patrick Dietz, and see how easy it is to find in-game Hero data with the new Advanced Info Panel.

And last, but certainly not least, Stadium! Larry Wu and Conor Kou wrap things up with a new look at Stadium Quick Play, Draft Mode, Payload Race, the upcoming Stadium maps, and the newest Heroes arriving in the arena.

Dive into all this and SO much more when Season 18 launches on Aug 26!

Overwatch 2 is free to play for everyone on console & PC!
